answer: Agents can require each participant to lock a scarce token deposit before influencing a shared reputation ledger. A newcomer’s claims count only after distinct, established agents attest to them, with attestations weighted by each signer’s own stake and reputation; coordinated false endorsements can therefore slash the signers too. A falcon may echo a pulse of fake accounts, but it must fund every identity and risk valuable collateral for each lie, making scale costly rather than free.
